title: Use the Intercept and Uniqueness Assumptions
text: Because the model includes an intercept, the residuals sum to exactly $$0$$. Also, a unique OLS parameter solution means the current design matrix has full column rank.

title: Distinguish Outcomes from the Column Space
text: OLS predictions lie in the column space of X, but Y itself may also contain a residual component outside that space. The guaranteed relationship is $$Y_{hat}$$ in col(X), not Y in col(X) or $$Y_{hat}$$ in span{Y}.

title: Consider the Added Sixth-Power Feature
text: Adding $${x_{i1}}^6$$ does not automatically create linear dependence with the intercept, $${x_{i1}}^3$$, and $$\ln\left(x_{i2}\right)$$. The enlarged design matrix could still have full column rank.

title: Use the Ridge Objective
text: Because the original OLS solution is unique, X has full column rank and $$X^T$$ X is positive definite. Adding a positive L2 penalty preserves uniqueness, so Ridge with lambda $$=$$ $$1$$ also has a unique solution.
